The 304l material also has lower carbon and reduces the possibilities of grain formation during welding. The material does not require pre heating or post weld heat treatment after welding. The pipes can also be seen in power generation plants, nuclear power plants, oil and gas, petrochemical and in other general engineering applications.

The material is made up of carbon, manganese, 23% nickel, 19% chromium, sulfur, 4% molybdenum, nitrogen, copper, phosphorus and silicon in the composition. The UNS N08904 Round Pipe is the most used shape where there are square, rectangular and hydraulic pipes. The material is especially corrosion resistant against brackish water and chloride ion. The pipes can range in wall thickness from 04mm to 30mm and schedules sch5 through XXH. The Stainless Steel 904L Pipe is one of the medium schedule pipes. These can be used with medium pressure applications. The pipes can range in dimensions with outer diameters ranging from ½ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes, ½ inches to 36 inches for ERW pipe and from 6 inches to 100 inches for the EFW pipe types.

The pipes can come with different pipe ends such as plain, beveled and treaded. The ASTM B677 TP 904L SS Seamless Pipes have high dimensional accuracy and are used in tools and equipment. The material has good strength with 490 MPa minimum tensile strength and 220 MPa minimum yield strength. With the corrosion resistance, strength and good elongation of 35% at break, the material is also used in making the SS 904L Capillary Tubes which are used in low volume precision applications. The applications of the pipes and tubes could be seen in boilers, heat exchangers, super heater elements, chemical processing, food processing, ship building, sea water and other general corrosive services as well.
